Name: Hold To Process Geodes
Author: jltaylor1
Description:
[size=5]Hold to Process Geodes
[/size]
[size=3]Once this mod is installed, clicking and holding the left mouse button inside the geode area on the blacksmith geode processing screen will repeatedly process the stack of items you are holding as long as the mouse button is held down - until you run out of items, inventory space, or gold.

Works great with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089]Fast Animations[/url]!

Compiled for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.

See the [url=https://github.com/jltaylor-us/StardewHoldToProcessGeodes]GitHub repository[/url] for source code and release notes.


[/size]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1689]Hold to Break Geodes[/url], which is no longer being maintained.
